author: Ozanne-Rivierre, Françoise
title: Iaai loanwords and phonemic changes in Fagauvea
notes: Consulted directly on 26 November 2026 (PDF of the volume in Downloads; tables read from page images). Fagauvea (West Uvean), the Polynesian Outlier of Ouvéa (Loyalty Islands), and its contact with Iaai. §2: sources of 1,335 roots (776 Polynesian, 423 Iaai, 37 Drehu, European). §3: innovations (PPN *t > t/d, *k > k/g in grammatical morphemes; the doubtful *m > m/hm, *n > n/hn), with Pawley's (1967) table of PPN and PNP reflexes (p. 527). §4: Polynesian loans with irregular h, s, Ø. §5: Iaai loans and the phonemic changes they brought (27 consonants and nine vowels after Hollyman 1987: 21, closed syllables), the semantic fields of loans and borrowed grammatical morphemes. Field work by Hollyman at Heo and by the author at Muli in 1971.
